quality.review_scope: Independent scoped scientific quick audit accepted original main PDF pp.1–6 and matched SI pp.1–5, 8, 11–12: SI-made CdSe seeds and CdSe/CdS core/shell inputs, ensemble Ag+ titration including optical intermediates and 0%/107% XRD, single-dot 10 µM/75 µL/min Ag flow, four 5/10/20/40 µM Figure 3 conditions, and pure-methanol control. Only ensemble endpoint XRD has phase labels; intermediate optical responses are not structural phase measurements. SI-only rod and model branches and unrelated ancillary measurements remain outside this main-text unit. ACS source-figure publisher reuse permission remains unverified.
missing_fields: Initial CdSe/CdS concentration and solution volume for the ensemble titration are not reported; exact total Ag+ stoichiometry cannot be reconstructed.
No direct phase, composition map or atom-resolved structure is measured for the individual OFF-switching nanocrystals.
Per-concentration flow rates for Figure 3's 5/10/20/40 µM distributions are not restated; do not inherit Figure 2's 75 µL/min.
Exact temperature of AgNO3 exchange, shell thickness and final product size distribution are not reported in the scoped text.
No quantitative fraction of short-lived partially exchanged intermediate particles is measured by the single-dot PL readout.
Figure 1 intermediate 21/35/48/60/80% optical titration states have no separately reported XRD phases or individual-particle composition maps.
conflicts: Main Figure 2 visual last snapshot labels 12.4 s while the caption says 12.1 s; both are kept in figure provenance.
Main p.2 calls CdSe cores typically 3.5 nm; SI p.2 estimates 3.4 nm for synthesized CdSe seeds from an excitonic transition. These are distinct descriptions, not an averaged size.

Main Fig. 1 final diffraction is Ag2Se/Ag2S, while main prose sometimes shortens single-dot OFF outcome to Ag2Se; preserve two-component product identity and separate direct ensemble XRD from optical single-dot inference.

SI Figure S8 calls the control pure methanol with no AgNO3, but its last caption sentence reports AgNO3 concentration/flow settings. Do not assign AgNO3 to the negative-control reagent without resolving the contradiction.
Main Figure 4 is a stochastic simulation, not observed atomistic structures or additional synthesized specimens.
